---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in the platform or AI analysis
title: "bug: "
---

## Observed problem
Describe the behavior and its impact.

## Owner and affected area
Owner: Ayşe / Ayşegül / Veli (select one).
Area: web / database / AI service / agent / RAG / analytics / integration.

## Reproduction steps
1. State the starting data, account role, or synthetic fixture.
2. Describe the action or command.
3. Describe the observed result.

## Expected behavior
Describe the correct result, including the relevant requirement or contract rule.

## Actual behavior
Include the response status, error code, or incorrect finding when applicable.

## Environment
Commit or branch:
Application/service version:
Operating system:
For AI problems, model name/version and relevant configuration:

## Evidence
Attach a minimal synthetic example, relevant logs, or source path and line references. For authorization problems identify roles and ownership relationships. Do not include actual passwords, tokens, or student personal data.

## Completion criterion
State a reproducible check that will demonstrate the fix.

## Dependencies
Related issue, contract, or teammate dependency, or none.
